notes.title: 1.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Update 1.0
It's been three weeks since we launched Skillsworn for early-access and we have already received such a welcome response from the community. We can't express how much we appreciate your feedback and we have worked hard to incorporate some of the most requested features. 

Be sure to check out our newly-added Skillsworn Manual which covers many of the core gameplay mechanics, combat tips, party management and more. 

Free Roam Camera

 Experience complete battlefield visibility with the new free roam camera. Keep a close eye on friends and foes alike with edge-to-edge camera movement. 
Default Controls
W A S D - Movement
Q E - Rotate  

Intelligence Intrinsic Bonus Change

 Intelligence now grants a percent chance to reflect spells on resist, replacing the bonus of increased energy.

New Adventure - King's Bridge

 The boglin scourge grows ever bolder, this time encroaching on the King's inter-coastal tracts!
New Destination - King's Pier
Among the King's most prized properties, the King's pier features pleasant year-round weather, beachside relaxation and unforgettable sunsets! 
Arcane Portal Destination
Your efforts to close the Arcane Portal on the King's Road have been successful (nice job!). Unfortunately an exact copy of the Arcane Portal has appeared near the King's Bridge. (The Arcane Portal destination has been moved from the King's Road to the King's Bridge).

Bog Adventure Party Size Increased to 6

 Despite your heroic triumphs in the bog, the boglins have bolstered their numbers. Gone are the days of small skirmishes, enlist your full party and take to arms!

New Destination - King's Road: Clifftop Hideout

 The townsfolk whisper of a hidden path along the King's Road leading to a remote overlook. What could be up there?

Additional Updates

New Skills!
Combat log tweaks
Floating combat text tweaks
Bug Fixes
